**5103 Stress ekkocardiogra** is a medical procedure code registered in the [[sygesikringsregisteret|Sygesikringsregisteret]] (National Health Service Register) in Denmark [^src1]. It is utilized specifically to identify stress echocardiography procedures within the framework of clinical quality measurement for patients with atrial fibrillation [^src1]. 

As part of the national quality assurance efforts coordinated by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code helps track whether atrial fibrillation patients receive appropriate diagnostic imaging [^src1]. The code is one of several specific echocardiography identifiers maintained in the register. According to the clinical indicator definitions, the complete list of echocardiography codes tracked for these quality metrics includes [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]], [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse]], [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse]], [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]], [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]], 5103 Stress ekkocardiogra, [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]], [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]], and [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] [^src1]. 

In the technical guidelines for calculating healthcare quality indicators, the broader clinical procedure of [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] is mapped to this code (among others) to define the numerators and denominators for performance metrics [^src2]. The continued use and documentation of the 5103 code across the 2023 [^src1], 2024 [^src2], and 2025 [^src3] annual reports of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) underscore its stable role in standardizing cardiovascular data collection and enabling cross-regional comparisons in the Danish healthcare system.
